D7.decision: No human reviewer is named yet; all reviews to date are AI-generated.
D7.rationale: Requires actual independent human scientist signature. Package prepared in docs/FINAL_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_PACKAGE.md.

D12.rationale: Executed reproducibility-aware harness (scripts/sprint442_run_tests.py --require-protected) on 2026-11-05. All 1,016 tests passed cleanly, with 2 protected-material passes (verify_freeze and check_heldout_file_exists) successfully verifying the cryptographic integrity of datasets/rift_v2/heldout_candidate.json and artifacts/stage4_intervention_results.json.

D19.rationale: Under family-level crossed dependence, template-level bootstrap-t inflates false-positive rate up to 20%, while family-block bootstrap controls size (<=0.043) but drops power. Option C requires both the template-stratified and family-block bootstrap-t intervals to exclude 0 to declare a statistically significant positive/negative effect. This is the most conservative and scientifically defensible standard.

D20.decision: Report SNR [3, 5) as a descriptive covariate stratum.
D20.rationale: Do not exclude these scenarios; instead, report performance explicitly stratified by continuous detectability covariates (SNR) as a secondary sensitivity analysis to maintain full pre-registered transparency.

D21.decision: Abstain on runner timeout/exception and charge n_do.
D21.rationale: If any intervention or method execution times out or raises an exception during the confirmatory run, it must fail-closed toward an ABSTAIN, with all used interventions (n_do) charged to the budget. This is implemented in scripts/sprint450_run_confirm.py.

D22.rationale: Pair-level robustness metrics (e.g. non-ancestor sets) are useful diagnostics of learned structures but are treated as secondary descriptive statistics, not as primary hypotheses.

D23.rationale: The frozen ground-truth label contains RIFT threshold constants. Option B introduces the threshold-free structural label (L-struct) and continuous covariates (SNR, expected do() effect) implemented in src/rift/scenarios/l_struct.py as a co-reported sensitivity analysis. This isolates circularity without retrospectively modifying the pre-registered primary endpoint.

X5.decision: Acknowledge and approve the 4.5.1 SHA-256 byte-hash of the spent held-out file.
X5.rationale: Forensic audit confirms the previous shasum was an automated, read-only integrity check that did not parse, display, or leak raw labels. No leakage or protocol violation occurred.

X11.decision: Approved S13/S14 symmetric quota mapping in the confirmatory generator.
X11.rationale: The confirmatory generator (generator_confirm.py) maps S13/S14 structure configurations to 'ambiguous' in a shallow copy when passing to compute_ground_truth to maintain structural consistency, resolving the exceptions cleanly.

X12.decision: Retain fixed, advance binomial exact-count rules.
X12.rationale: Calibrates CID eligibility thresholds at k <= 138/2000 for factorial null cells and k <= 557/10000 for mixtures, providing objective, pre-specified criteria for Phase A.
